visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Return the First Pair from a Function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A found flag, two result variables and a full double loop keep running after the answer is known. Put the search in a function that returns as soon as it finds a pair. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Returning from the function stops the search at the first match and the return value replaces the found flag. Starting j at i + 1 removes the need for the i != j test.
